name: Slack green emails
ownerWords: also your duty is to keep monitor Resend if there are no false-positive emails being sent or we're being annoying.
goal: No Slack Green email is wrong or annoying. Wrong is a connect nudge after a workspace is connected, an email to a deleted account, a removed email, or marketing after an opt-out. Annoying is the same email twice in a day or over 2 connect nudges per person. Bounces plus complaints stay under Resend's 4% guide.

metrics.label: Bad emails sent in the last day
Emails sent to someone they no longer fit, last 24 h
Repeat emails or connect nudges past 2 per person, last 24 h
Sends that bounced or were marked spam, last 24 h

onMiss: A failed source counts in the headline: fix the precheck or its key first. For each wrong or annoying send flagged, write on p68 the template, the user id (never the address) and why, find the slack-green code path that sent it, and start one fix job that opens a PR, or message the live job that owns that cause. A run with a miss ends with a job on each cause. If one template floods, turn its flag off at once (CONNECT_REMINDER_ENABLED on Railway slack-green-backend or PHONE_SETUP_EMAIL_AUTO_ENABLED on Vercel) and tell the chat. Bounces or complaints over 4%: start one fix job on the cause. The flag change is the only prod change; never email users or merge.
